description:
SUBSCRIBER SUGGESTION VIDEO:

When IDKFPV suggested this Ben & Jerry's France only flavour (at the time of making this video), I had to check it out as they described it well and it sounded amazing. Well.......... here we are, a couple of weeks later and i'm making ben & jerry's caramel brownie party. 

As mentioned in the video, I have used Patriks Svenssons caramel ice cream base from his Häagen Dazs recipe, i've just adjusted it for my own preference. You can find this recipe here: https://icecreamcalc.com/2021/04/16/salted-caramel-haagen-dazs-style/

I promise you, you will NOT be dissapointed with it.

WARNING:
If you don't like add ins in your ice cream.......this is NOT for you. 

Ice Cream base ingredients:
335ml Milk
340ml Cream
100g Sugar
50g Dextrose
1-2 Egg yolk s
60g of Caramel Sauce (see below)
42g SMP
1.5g Stabiliser

Caramel Sauce:
300g Sugar
110g butter
110ml cream
3/4-1tsp Salt

Brownies:
110g Butter
150g Plain Flour (all purpose)
35g Cocoa Powder
1/2tsp Baking Powder
1/2tsp Salt
275g Bournville Chocolate 
275g Sugar
3 Eggs
Bake @ 160c for 22mins

Cookie Pieces of your choosing. 

Yes there are a lot of things going on here but what a combo it is. The caramel melts in your mouth, the brownie texture is perfect, the cookie crunch is amazing and the ice cream itself is mind blowing. 

I urge you to give this on a shot and also go and download Partiks Ice Cream calculator for your Windows machine. 

If you enjoyed this video, please consider liking and subscribing, plus pop over to our Instagram and Facebook pages linked below and say hello :)

Instagram: https://tinyurl.com/2p85zcxh
Facebook: http://tiny.cc/mmxosz
Website: https://polaricecreamery.com/


Thanks and see you on the next video :)

comments.text: Hahah don’t stress too much about what stabilizer I use. Whatever you have is fine and use 1.5g per 1kg of ice cream mix. Ava will work cold too but it need a little time to hydrate. Let the base sit in the refrigerator for a couple of hours to allow it to do that.
